To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
employee commitment and supply integration have a positive impact on operational performance, and that employee commitment has an indirect positive effect on performance through internal integration.
employee commitment and supply-chain integration are both important to organizational performance, and that they are related.

(1) Employee commitment and internal integration mutually reinforce each other; (2) Internal integration is a key driver of supply chain integration; (3) Employee commitment and supply chain management implementation are positively related.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interrelationships among employee commitment, supply chain integration and organisational performance, and provides new insights for managers and researchers.
the role that employees can play in the supply chain management process.
the relationship between employee and supply chain integration, and its impact on performance, as well as the interrelationship between the different dimensions of integration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
employee commitment is the most important factor for supply chain integration and organisational performance.
the more integrated a supply chain is, the more effective the supply chain is in terms of performance.
employee commitment is an important antecedent to supply chain integration and a necessary condition for achieving operational performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
employee commitment is an antecedent factor of supply chain integration, and supply chain integration is the key factor of performance.
employee commitment is a key factor in the success of the implementation of supply chain management.
employee commitment has an important role in the supply chain integration-performance relationship.
The main takeaway from our work is that

employee commitment and supply integration have a strong and positive impact on operational performance, and the effect of employee commitment on performance is fully mediated through supply integration.
employee commitment and supply chains integration are two sides of the same coin, and both should be managed simultaneously in order to obtain a better supply chain performance.
managers should strive to achieve a high level of both employee commitment and supply-chain integration, since they mutually reinforce each others' effects.
